## Observer data

<ul style="list-style-type: none;">
  <li>
    <strong>Nombre del observador:</strong>
    <input type="text" name="nombre_observador" size="40" placeholder="Full name">
  </li>
  <li>
    <strong>Fecha de observación:</strong>
    <input type="date" name="fecha_observacion">
  </li>
</ul>

## General student information

<ul style="list-style-type: none;">
  <li>
    <strong>Nombre del alumno:</strong>
    <input type="text" name="nombre_alumno" size="40" placeholder="Student's full name">
  </li>
  <li>
    <strong>Fecha de nacimiento:</strong>
    <input type="date" name="fecha_nacimiento">
  </li>
  <li>
    <strong>Edad:</strong>
    <input type="number" name="edad" min="0" max="100" placeholder="Age">
  </li>
  <li>
    <strong>Clase o asignatura:</strong>
    <input type="text" name="clase" size="40" placeholder="e.g.: 3rd ESO - Biology">
  </li>
</ul>

    color: white;
    border: none;
    padding: 14px 32px;
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: bold;
    border-radius: 6px;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
  ">
    ⬇ Download as PDF
  </button>
  <p style="font-size: 13px; color: #666; margin-top: 8px;">
    In the print dialog, select <strong>"Save as PDF"</strong> as the destination.
  </p>
</div>

<script>
function imprimirPDF() {
  const nombre = document.querySelector('input[name="nombre_alumno"]')?.value?.trim();
  const fecha  = document.querySelector('input[name="fecha_observacion"]')?.value;

  if (!nombre) {
    const ok = confirm("The \"Student name\" field is empty.\nDo you want to continue anyway?");
    if (!ok) return;
  }

  const tituloOriginal = document.title;
  if (nombre) {
    const sufijo = fecha ? `_${fecha}` : "";
    document.title = `Observation_${nombre.replace(/\s+/g, "_")}${sufijo}`;
  }

  window.print();

  setTimeout(() => { document.title = tituloOriginal; }, 1500);
}
</script>

<style>
@media print {
  .navbar, .nav-footer, #quarto-sidebar, #TOC, .quarto-title-banner,
  .quarto-title-meta, #pdf-btn-container, .page-navigation,
  #quarto-margin-sidebar, header.quarto-title-block, .quarto-secondary-nav {
    display: none !important;
  }
  body { font-size: 11pt; color: #000; }
  #quarto-content { margin: 0 !important; padding: 0 !important; max-width: 100% !important; }
  input[type="text"],
  input[type="date"],
  input[type="number"] {
    border: none !important;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #555 !important;
    background: transparent !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
    -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact;
    print-color-adjust: exact;
  }
  input[type="checkbox"] {
    width: 13px;
    height: 13px;
    -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact;
    print-color-adjust: exact;
    appearance: auto;
    -webkit-appearance: auto;
  }
  textarea {
    border: 1px solid #999 !important;
    min-height: 80px;
    -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact;
    print-color-adjust: exact;
  }
  h2 { page-break-before: always; }
  h2:first-of-type { page-break-before: avoid; }
}
</style>
